d: I tested 3 methods for consolidating iron prills into a single mass of iron. First, I tried melting the iron in a crucible in an open forge. The prills came together in larger masses but the crucible tipped over and they spilled out. Next I built a small furnace and tipped the iron in through the top. The iron melted or welded together quite well o the point that 2/3rds of the iron was in a single mass.
